statement_en: Two papers support regular disease checks and standard, careful medication for mandarin fish. One says this lowers disease rates and raises survival, and the other says to check fish regularly, treat according to the disease, and avoid highly toxic or high-residue drugs; both are stated as claims, with no measured results given.
statement_zh: 两篇文献都支持对鳜鱼定期检查、规范用药。一篇认为建立常态化病害监测并科学规范用药，可降低病害发生率、提高成活率；另一篇提出要定期检查鱼体、对症下药，并禁用高毒、高残留和不安全的药物。两者都是文献中的论述，没有给出实测数据。

practice_en: oral health feed with water and bottom regulation
practice_zh: 拌料内服保健与调水改底

strength.en: All 1 claims come from one paper.
strength.zh: 全部 1 条论断来自同一篇论文。
strength.rule: one paper; described if more claims describe than take a side; agree or against at 80% or more one way; otherwise mixed

statement_en: Farmers in excellent cases improved fish immunity by regularly mixing health supplements into feed for oral administration, and persisted in adjusting water quality and improving the bottom environment to enhance the farming conditions, thereby achieving fewer disease occurrences.
statement_zh: 优秀案例中的养殖户通过定期拌料内服保健品以提高鱼体免疫力，并坚持调水和改底以改善养殖环境，从而实现了较少的病害发生。

strength.en: Of 2 claims that take a side: 2 in favour, 0 against or no effect. At least 80% point one way.
strength.zh: 2 条有明确倾向的论断中，2 条支持，0 条反对或无效果，至少 80% 指向同一方向。
strength.rule: one paper; described if more claims describe than take a side; agree or against at 80% or more one way; otherwise mixed

basis.summary: Both claims are supportive but only C15987 links the practice to reduced outbreak risk, and it is a claim rather than a measurement, while C16113 describes monitoring only, so I kept the wording cautious and noted there is no disagreement.

statement_en: Two papers support regular sampling and dissection for mandarin fish disease and parasite problems. One says that stronger regular sampling checks allow early detection and prevention of parasitic disease and may lower the risk of outbreaks. The other only describes using sampling and dissection to look at internal organs to monitor tissue health and disease. Neither claim gives a measured welfare outcome or specific conditions.
statement_zh: 两篇文献都支持对鳜鱼定期抽样和解剖来应对病害和寄生虫问题。一篇认为加强定期抽样检查可以早监测、早预防寄生虫病，从而降低病害暴发的风险；另一篇只是描述通过抽样解剖观察内脏器官来监测组织健康和病害情况。两条都没有给出具体的福利效果数据，也没有说明适用条件。

strength.en: All 2 claims come from one paper.
strength.zh: 全部 2 条论断来自同一篇论文。
strength.rule: one paper; described if more claims describe than take a side; agree or against at 80% or more one way; otherwise mixed

basis.summary: Only one paper with two supportive claims; one is background about carp in vitro and the other is a stated view, so neither measures an effect in mandarin fish and I described them as possibilities, with no disagreement to handle.

statement_en: The two claims, both from one 2021 paper, only say that RNA interference could help control viral disease. One reports that targeting the svcv-L gene reduced viral replication in vitro in carp, and the other says RNAi is considered usable for making antiviral agents in aquaculture. Neither reports a measured effect on mandarin fish welfare.
statement_zh: 这两条结论都出自同一篇2021年的论文，只是说RNA干扰有可能用于控制病毒病。一条提到针对svcv-L基因的RNAi在体外可减少鲤鱼体内病毒复制，另一条说RNAi被认为可用于水产养殖中研制抗病毒制剂。两条都没有给出在鳜鱼上实测的福利效果。
